answer: Identity bond decay: a new identity posts a 100 POA bond that loses 5% each idle epoch, restored only by verified work. It docks at a single jetty, then must earn its way across the tundra of unrelated jobs, each completed job a pearl on its public record. One fake costs 100 POA plus 5 POA per idle epoch; 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 POA plus 5,000 POA per idle epoch. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards undiluted.
